dedupe_keys.name: openlca nexus repository of free and paid life cycle inventory databases and models

description: openLCA Nexus is the online source of life cycle assessment data sets for the openLCA software: a searchable marketplace in which data providers offer life cycle inventory databases, input-output databases, data set libraries and ready-made models, some free and many paid. Coverage: global; the dataset search service on 28 September 2026 reported 505,058 indexed data sets (almost all unit or aggregated processes, plus 62 product systems), with facets for database, country, location, category, review type, end-of-life modelling, infrastructure and emission modelling, validity year and price. The largest collections by indexed processes were Carbon Minds cm.chemicals, EuGeos 15804-IA, ecoinvent (v2.2 and v3.12), a Circularity Package and an EN 15804 add-on; by data type about 360,600 indexed items are LCI databases, 51,400 input-output and 23,200 data set libraries, and about 102,500 belong to models. Format and access: web search and account-based download or purchase for use in openLCA (formats are listed per database and were not read); many databases are free, others priced per licence, with about 217,000 indexed items in the lowest price band (up to 1). Licence: set per database by each data provider; not read. Caveats: the counts are index facets, not distinct resources; commercial databases such as ecoinvent need a paid licence; the about and licence-type pages render by script and were not read. Simulation uses: background inventories of materials, energy, transport and waste processes for embodied-carbon and life cycle optimisation of infrastructure assets. Related records: the data are built for openLCA (platform-openlca), and the US LCI database (data-us-life-cycle-inventory-database-uslci) is one of the free inventories of this kind.
